parts.latex: Find the minimum time needed to complete the project.
State the critical path for the project.
Determine the float time of activity I.

meta.format_note: Kept source \exfigure. Rubric written by us.
Arrows in the critical path are path notation, not reasoning. Rubric written by us.

solutions.latex:
The float time of $I$ is the latest start time minus the earliest start time minus the duration.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Float time of } I &= 17-7-5 \\ &= 5 \text{ minutes} \end{aligned}$$

parts.latex:
A project requires activities A to F to be completed. The activity chart shows the immediate prerequisites and duration for each activity.

\exfigure{1266_q39_1}

A new activity, $X$, is added to the project, and has $A$ as an immediate prerequisite. No other activity has $X$ as an immediate prerequisite.

By first drawing a network diagram showing all seven activities, find the maximum duration of $X$ if it does not increase the minimum time to complete the project.

solutions.latex:
\exfigure{1266_q39_s1}

From the network diagram, the critical path of the original activities is $A, C, D, E$, with a minimum project time of 15 minutes.

$X$ has $A$ as its immediate prerequisite, so it cannot start until $A$ finishes, at 6 minutes. No activity depends on $X$, so draw an edge from $X$ to the End.

For the project time to stay at 15 minutes, $X$ must finish by 15 minutes, starting at 6 minutes.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Maximum duration} &= 15 - 6 \\ &= 9 \text{ minutes} \end{aligned}$$

solutions.latex:
Delaying activity $I$ by $10$ hours makes it start at $16+10=26$.

It takes $7$ hours, so it finishes at $26+7=33$.

This is within the latest allowed time, so the project finish is not delayed: $0$ hours.

Hence the correct option is the one equal to $0$.

parts.latex: Find the minimum time to complete the project.
State the critical path for this project

A new task, X, is to be added to the project. The earliest starting time for X is 17 minutes, the latest starting time for X is 18 minutes and X has a completion time of 12 minutes. Add task X to the given network diagram above AND state the float time for this task.

solutions.latex:
The minimum time is the length of the critical path.
$$\therefore\ 40 \text{ minutes}$$
$$\therefore\ A, C, D, E, G, J, K$$

criteria: Adds task $X$ correctly, or states the float time, or equivalent merit
